name: Normal Conversation
description: Casual daily conversation without any social engineering or security requests.

request.transcript: Hey, are we still meeting at 5 today?

name: Suspicious Request
description: Requesting account details under vague verification pretext.

request.transcript: Can you send me your account details? I need to verify something.

name: High Risk Impersonation
description: Bank impersonation combined with account blocking threat, OTP request, and financial transfer demand.

request.transcript: I'm calling from your bank. Your account will be blocked. Tell me your OTP and transfer ₹20,000 immediately.

name: Remote Access Attack
description: Technical support impersonation requesting remote access tool installation.

request.transcript: I'm from technical support. Install this application and give me remote access to your computer.

name: Contextual OTP Statement (False Positive Test)
description: User mentioning bank security guidance about never sharing OTP. Should NOT trigger OTP request alarm.

request.transcript: The bank told me never to share my OTP with anyone over the phone.
